own_role: One duty cycle monitor sample per 100 ms while bit 3 of algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal is set and engine_state is not STOPPED: stamps the map start times, forms the load ratio (FSFNFL - NLFL) x 10000 / (full throttle fueling - NLFL) (FSMXTHFL inside DCMNLOES..DCMNHIES, else the ALPHA blend of the steady state / transient 4D fueling lookups at the cutoff speed), bins engine speed (8) and load (6) into region 1-48 (49 / 50 for a negative ratio) and adds 1 to that region's counter and total in the long term map (cap 3600000000) and in the active short term processing map.
reason: Re-derived from 0xac3c-0xaf6e: andi.w #8 on 0x803cb8, cmpi #1 engine_state, x 10000 shift-add + divs.l, two axis searches (0x807d20 x8, 0x807d34 x6), region = (6 - load) x 8 + speed, 49 / 50 for a negative ratio, addq.l on 0x80546e / 0x80bada / 0x80bba8 + 4 x region. It is the only writer of the region, load factor and map counters; 0xaf70 / 0xb130 only convert. Agrees with the describer. CM848 0x50638c has the same skeleton but 10 load bins, a 13000 clamp, no short term maps: counterpart, so cm550_ and the parallel name. Name unique in both CSVs.

own_role: Boost pressure sensor in-range high diagnostic (Cummins 433): with bit 4 of word 27 set, engine RUNNING, neither boost circuit fault (status word 1 bits 0x400 / 0x200 together with the same DGFUIDEN bits) active, engine speed at most LSRF + DGLSRSOF and JCPCLD at most DGLWTD, counts a dwell to DGBSDCTR, then debounces boost > DGSTBSTD up / down; above DGBSHTTD sets bit 0x2000 of status word 1 and its first occurrence bit, at 0 clears the status bit; a failed condition resets dwell 0 / debounce 1.
reason: Name confirmed: the only reader of the five 123D records and the only setter / clearer of mask 0x2000 of 0x806002 (RAM dump: DGFUCATB word 29 -> index 91 -> code 433; bits 25 / 26 -> 122 / 123). The CM848 record names (boost_pressure_sensor_high_reading_*) support the wording; the describer's ...InRangeHighError says the same. Counterpart of the last block of cm848_monitorBoostPressureSensorAndUnderboost (same tests, larger CM848 body). Comment amended: 0x806abe is word 1 of e2m DGFUIDEN (000F +570, 'bit mapped parameter used to disable / enable the processing of a fault'), read-only in the dumped ROM, not 'confirm bits' (the frozen row name fault_confirm_status_word_1 is the old pass's guess).
final_comment: Boost pressure in-range high check (e2m 123D DGBSDCTR / DGBSHTTD / DGLWTD / DGLSRSOF / DGSTBSTD; enable = bit 4 of algorithm_enable_flags_27_cal, DGBSIREN), once per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase1. It runs while engine_state is RUNNING, neither boost pressure circuit fault is active (bit 0x400 / 0x200 of system error status word 1 = Cummins codes 123 / 122, each counted only while the same bit of word 1 of the fault processing enable bitmap DGFUIDEN, 0x806abe, is set), engine speed ESCMES is at most LSRF + DGLSRSOF and percent load JCPCLD is at most DGLWTD; otherwise the dwell count is zeroed and the debounce count set to 1. After DGBSDCTR passes of dwell the debounce count goes up while boost pressure BSTPRS is above DGSTBSTD and down otherwise; above DGBSHTTD it sets bit 0x2000 of system error status word 1 and of the first occurrence word (fault code 433), and at 0 it clears the status bit once the first occurrence bit is clear. The counterpart of the last block of cm848_monitorBoostPressureSensorAndUnderboost.

own_role: Idle shutdown state machine: word 3 bit 1 set and word 28 bit 4 clear, then a six-way jump table (0x1da00) on ISST 0x80d674: RESET reloads ISTM and clears ISWRRQ / ISOD / ISODFG / output 30; COUNT counts down to WARNING (or DELAY with ISAATPEN + ISODFG); WARNING raises ISWRRQ and after ISWRTMLM passes goes to SHUTDOWN (or OVERRIDE / RESET); DELAY 600-pass countdown to OVERRIDE; OVERRIDE sets ISOD / ISODRQ; SHUTDOWN sets SHSS and output 30 once and returns to RESET when CRANKING; saves the entry state in 0x800752.
reason: Name confirmed: the only writer of ISST besides the initializer and the only idle shutdown code that sets SHSS; both roles agree. CM848: no access to Idle_Shutdown_Period 0x3fdd4c / Min / Max IMT (lis+displacement scan finds the neighbour 0x3fdd50 four times), engine_shutdown_command_flag stored only at 0x216f0 / 0x508d1c / 0x508e18, no idle shutdown name in its CSVs and only calibration leftovers in its e2m: the task's premise of a CM848 machine does not hold, so standalone. Comment amended: the flags are not writer-less - cm550_initializeIdleShutdown sets ISRSFG to 1 and RESET / the initializer clear ISODFG; no code sets them while running.
final_comment: Idle shutdown state machine (e2m 10CD; state ISST 0 RESET / 1 COUNT / 2 WARNING / 3 DELAY / 4 OVERRIDE / 5 SHUTDOWN), one pass per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase11 while ISAGEN (idle_shutdown_enable, bit 1 of algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal) is set and ISTAEN (integrated_idle_management_enable, bit 4 of word 28) is clear. RESET reloads the timer ISTM from ISTMLM, clears ISWRRQ / ISOD / ISODFG, switches output 30 off and waits for ISRSFG = 0; COUNT counts ISTM down, returns to RESET on ISRSFG = 1 and enters WARNING when ISTM is at or below ISWRTMLM (or DELAY, 600 passes before OVERRIDE, when ISAATPEN and ISODFG are set); WARNING keeps counting, sets ISWRRQ and after ISWRTMLM passes enters SHUTDOWN, unless ISODEN with ISODFG gives OVERRIDE or ISRSWNFG gives RESET; OVERRIDE reloads the timer, sets ISOD and ISODRQ and waits for ISODRSFG; SHUTDOWN sets the engine shutdown command SHSS and switches output 30 on once, and returns to RESET when the engine is CRANKING. No code in the dumped ROM sets ISRSFG / ISRSWNFG / ISODRSFG / ISODFG while running (cm550_initializeIdleShutdown sets ISRSFG to 1 at start-up; RESET and the initializer clear ISODFG). CM848 S90140.06 has no idle shutdown machine.

own_role: Three warning-lamp flashes: ticks 1-5, 24-29 and 48-53 of a 72-tick cycle on lamp request bit 0x2, busy latch 0x801a1c set in the first on phase and cleared with the count at tick 72; run while OCRSFG or the latch is set.

own_role: The 50 ms lamp control task: only the power-up sequence while 0x8019d2 is set; else fault code flash out, then the shutdown warning flashes, then the active fault lamps, each only when the previous returns idle; the three oil change monitor flash patterns on their conditions; saves switch bits 0x20 / 0x40 / 0x80 of 0x80bccf for edge detection.
reason: Both roles agree and the code confirms the priority order (tst.b d0 after 0x24d40 / 0x249ee) and conditions (0x801a22 window 100..399 with OCITWNFG, OCRSFG or 0x801a1c, OCRNSTEA + OCITWNFG + RUNNING). LAMP_CON is the e2m group (G record, group 0x30 LAMP_CONTROL) of the LC records. Single caller 0x1b70c.

own_role: QSPI interrupt handler of the serial EEPROM driver (movem, rte): clears SPIF in QSM_SPSR, runs the driver step 0x266da, sets SPE in QSM_SPCR1.
reason: No caller: its address is stored in 0x808f20 at 0x26860 = VBR 0x808ddc (movec at 0x28650) + 4 x 0x51 (QIVR 0x50 at 0x2866c, QSPI vector = QIVR | 1); the RAM dump holds 0x00026834 there. Counterpart of cm848_onQspiFinished (CM848's serves a shared QSPI job queue). Name confirmed; comment amended only for the renamed callee (mc68k_runSerialEepromDriverStep).
final_comment: QSPI interrupt handler of the serial EEPROM driver (reached through RAM vector 81 at 0x808f20 = VBR 0x808ddc + 4 x 0x51, installed by mc68k_initializeSerialEepromDriverAndLoadMirror; not called). It clears SPIF (QSM_SPSR bit 7), runs mc68k_runSerialEepromDriverStep (stores the 12 words just read into the EEPROM mirror and queues the next read, or sends / polls a queued byte write) and sets SPE (QSM_SPCR1 bit 15) to start the next queue pass. The counterpart of cm848_onQspiFinished.

own_role: Empty function: a single rts, called once by bsr.s at 0x2685e at the start of 0x26854.
reason: Body is 4e75 between the rte of 0x26834 and the prologue of 0x26854; only reference is the bsr.s. The repository's empty-function convention (cm550_emptyStubFunction4 / 7; CM848 cm848_emptyStubFunction3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8) states only what the code shows; 10 is unused in the frozen and live CSVs (9 was the deleted 0x303c8). Kept rather than skipped (the describer would skip it): the name claims nothing beyond 'empty'.

own_role: Serial EEPROM driver start-up (called once at 0x28674): installs the QSPI vector, configures PQSPAR / DDRQS / PORTQS, SPCR0 0x8004, queue 2-15 (READ, address, 12 data words), sets ram_refresh_enable, state 0, base 0x803b0a, loads 0x148a bytes by polling (driver step + both watchdogs) until the loaded flag, then DTL 0x23, SPIFIE, SPE and the refresh length 0x64c.
reason: Re-derived from 0x26854-0x269f0: lengths (0x804f94 - 0x803b08) - 2 = 0x148a (RAM 0x803b0a-0x804f93) and (0x804156 - 0x803b08) - 2 = 0x64c (RAM 0x803b0a-0x804155); dump offset 0x4c8, length 0x64c, state 0, base 0x803b0a, loaded 1. It is the initializer, not the loop step. Counterpart of cm848_initEepromDriverAndLoadMirror (same variable order, QSPI job layer, checksum). Name confirmed; comment amended only for the renamed callee.
final_comment: Start-up of the serial EEPROM driver, called once by mc68k_applicationMain after the QSM interrupt set-up. It stores mc68k_serialEepromQspiInterruptHandler in RAM vector 0x808f20, configures the QSPI (master, 16 bits, queue entries 2 to 15: READ, the address, 12 data words), sets ram_refresh_enable (e2m 10C7 RREN) and the mirror base 0x803b0a, and with the length 0x148a runs the queue by polling (mc68k_runSerialEepromDriverStep after each pass, both watchdogs serviced) until the mirror is loaded. Then it enables the QSPI interrupt and sets the length to 0x64c, so the driver keeps refreshing RAM 0x803b0a-0x804155 (the _cal range) from the EEPROM. The counterpart of cm848_initEepromDriverAndLoadMirror.

own_role: SPT0PCLD (0x80db62) = (FSFNFL - NLFL) x 25600 / (FST0MXFL - NLFL) when both fuelings are above NLFL (unsigned compares), else 0; divu.l with the low word stored, no clamp.

The investigator's discriminator 'only reader of FST0MXFL' is not true (cm550_updateElectronicSmartPowerTau reads it at 0x1ac3e, cm550_FUN_0001cc72 writes it), but the name rests on the SPT0PCLD output. own_role: Flashes the warning lamp for ISWRRQ and the stop lamp for EPSQ (LCLPONTM / LCLPFFTM), and the warning lamp 120 times (10 on / 10 off) after ISODRQ = 1, then clears ISODRQ; returns 1 only when none is active.

own_role: Fault code flash out while the diagnostic switch (0x80bccf bit 0x80) is on and the engine STOPPED: selects the first / next / previous fault on switch edges or the next one in automatic mode after LCFUFHCU repetitions, flashes its code via 0x24b4e or lights both lamps when there is none, returns 0; when inactive it clears both lamp bits once and returns 1.

reason: Re-derived from 0x24f30-0x25314; both roles agree. No state word, so 'state machine' was wrong; the investigator's name and the describer's cm550_updateLampRequestsFromActiveFaults both fit, the proposal is kept.

own_role: Five groups of three flashes on lamp request bit 0x4 (on in ticks 1-5, 12-17, 24-29 of a 48-tick group; group count 0x801a16 stops at 5); called 100..399 lamp task passes after the power-up sequence while OCITWNFG is set.

Bit 0x4 is output 4, which the e2m calls the engine protection lamp (EPLPPZ, LCEGPNLP) and the fluids lamp (LCDGFDLP, FLLPONTM); the repository already has engine_protection_lamp_override_priority for it, so the proposal's wording is sourced. No fault is involved.

own_role: FSPCLD (0x80db60) = (FSFNFL - NLFL) x 0x6400 / (FSMXTHFL - NLFL) clamped at 0x7f80; JCPCLD (0x80db5e) = the same fuel over the fueling available at the current speed (HSG droop line above HSRFBFDP with HSDPFG, clamped at 0x1700; else FSMXTHFL), clamped at 0x7f80 and forced to 0x6400 while final_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_HIGH_SPEED_GOVERNOR (12).
reason: Re-derived from 0x26cc8-0x26e2a; only writer of 0x80db60 / 0x80db5e. Both roles agree. Counterpart of cm848_calculateEngineLoadPercentages (same constants, different full-load reference and branches), hence the prefixed parallel name; the old unprefixed calculateSpeedRatioComponent was wrong.

own_role: Copies each lamp request bit of 0x80daac to its discrete output image bit while that output's override priority byte (0x80bd1a + n) is 0: 0x20 and 0x40 -> output 30, 0x04 -> 4, 0x01 -> 1, 0x08 -> 0, 0x02 -> 6, 0x10 -> 2.
reason: Re-derived from 0x23a90-0x23be4 (called by 0x24804 in the 10-frame set of phase 6). No protection condition is tested; the old unprefixed name was wrong and no CM848 row carries it. Not covered by the describer; the code is unambiguous.

own_role: Flashes one three-digit fault code: warning lamp on for 40 ticks, then stop-lamp flashes of the hundreds / tens / ones digits at phases 40 / 80 / 120 with 40-tick gaps, cycle complete at phase 160.
reason: Re-derived (0x24b4e-0x24c58); same name from both roles; argument = the fault record's code word pushed at 0x24ef4.

own_role: Returns the next active fault for the flash out: steps fault_list_navigation_index forward through active_dtc_list (1 on 125 or past the end), skipping faults with control bit 0x40; 125 when none.
reason: Re-derived (0x24c5a-0x24cd0); forward step (addq.b) versus the sibling's subq.b. It returns a fault index, not a code, so ...FaultToFlash is slightly more exact than the describer's ...FaultCodeToFlash.

reason: Re-derived (0x24cd2-0x24d3e); only caller is the idle decrement edge (0x24e4c). Both roles agree.

own_role: One step of the serial EEPROM driver after each QSPI queue pass: state 0 (no write) copies the 12 received words into the RAM mirror (while ram_refresh_enable), advances / wraps the offset (setting the loaded flag) and sets the next READ address, or moves to state 1 when writes are queued; state 1 sends WREN + WRITE of the next queued byte and goes to state 2; state 2 polls RDSR until the write is done, then the next write or back to reading at the saved offset.
reason: The investigator keeps the name and calls it 'incomplete rather than wrong'. The judge renames it: state 0 - the start-up mirror load and the continuous RAM refresh that make 0x803b0a-0x804155 EEPROM-backed - is this function's normal path, and 'runSerialEepromWriteQueue' names only states 1 / 2, so a reader looking for the mirror refresh would not find it. mc68k_runSerialEepromDriverStep states the role (one step per QSPI pass, called by the interrupt handler and by the start-up poll loop), keeps the mc68k_ prefix (QSM transmit / receive RAM) and is unused in both firmwares. The investigator's plate comment fits the new name unchanged. Standalone (CM848 splits the step over three functions).

e2m 10CD +2 ISST at this address; word accesses only (movea #imm at 0x1d9b8, clr.w 0x1db9a, move.w 0x33d44); all six values proven by the state machine; CM848 has no idle shutdown state, so no shared name. Enum type IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE (size 2) confirmed below.
e2m 10CD +4 ISTM (0.1 s per count); word accesses only (reload at 0x1da0c / 0x1db22 / 0x1db90, subq.w at 0x1da4c / 0x1daa4, PID 71 reads 0xefa4 / 0xefac / 0xeff0); dump 36000.
e2m 10CD +8 ISWRRQ; set in WARNING, cleared in RESET / OVERRIDE / SHUTDOWN / init, read by the lamp function (0x24a0c) and PID 71 (0xeffc); word accesses.
e2m 10CD +A ISRSFG; tst.w in RESET, cmpi.w #1 in COUNT and DELAY, move.w #1 only in the initializer; word accesses.
e2m 10CD +10 ISODFG ('override procedure was successful'); clr.w in RESET / init, cmpi.w #1 in COUNT (with ISAATPEN) and WARNING (with ISODEN); not a sensor fault.
e2m 10CD +12 ISODRQ; move.w #1 in OVERRIDE, cmpi.w #1 / clr.w in the lamp function (0x24adc / 0x24b40), clr.w in init.
e2m 10CD +0 ISOD; clr.w in RESET / init, move.w #1 in OVERRIDE, tst.w in PID 71 (0xefce); the other two hits are the parameter ID table (0x35a04). No frozen row.
e2m 10CD +C ISRSWNFG; only reference cmpi.w #1 at 0x1dad0 (WARNING -> RESET). No frozen row.
e2m 10CD +E ISODRSFG; only reference cmpi.w #1 at 0x1db3a (OVERRIDE -> RESET). No frozen row.

e2m 0008 +66 ISTMLM (0.1 s; 36000 in the dump); inside the EEPROM mirror (EEPROM 0xf8), so _cal is right; word reads at 0x1da0c / 0x1db22 / 0x1db90 / 0xefb2. CM848 has the record at 0x3fdd4c with no row and no reader.
e2m 10CC +8 ISWRTMLM (0.1 s; 300 in the dump); outside the mirror, so no _cal; only cmp.w at 0x1da8e / 0x1dae6.
No e2m record; move.w of the entry state at 0x1db7e and cmpi.w #5 at 0x1db48 only. Name follows the repository's <thing>_previous pattern.
No e2m record; clr.w in COUNT, addq.w in WARNING, compared with ISWRTMLM at 0x1dae0; only references. Old vp44_sensor_failure_counter was wrong.
No e2m record; move.w #600 in COUNT, tst / subq.w in DELAY, tst.w before OVERRIDE; only references.

Slot 30 of the per-output override priority array 0x80bd1a + n (the power-up sequence and cm550_applyLampRequestsToOutputs index it that way; image bit = 0x80bcf9 bit 0x40); no e2m record at 12A7 +1E; byte accesses only. Output 30's driver is not identifiable in this build (ISDR text says bit 4; 000E +2B mask 0x40 records are Top2 solenoids; cm550_ioControlBasedFuelCalculator tests the bit five times and mc68k_initializeDiscreteOutputDrivers sets it five times - checked), so the neutral name is the right level of claim. The frozen engine_brake_lamp_driver_control is unsupported.

Long accesses only (move.l at 0xadd8 / 0xae18, tst.l at 0xae1e; the other abs hits are the RAM-base immediate of the RAM test / clear loops); signed (divs.l, bge). The low word 0x800002 (row rpm_control_timer_1, one move.w at 0xae4a) is absorbed - correct.
Word writes at 0xad2a / 0xad4a / 0xadb0 / 0xadb8, reads at 0xadc2 / 0xae04; no other code reference.
Long accesses only (cmp.l x7, move.l at 0xb002 / 0xb02a / 0xb06a); dump 18000000 = 500 h x 36000. The row 0x800008 (no reference) is its low word and goes.
Word write at 0xb016 (x 60), cmp.w at 0xb022 / 0xb062, read through a1 at 0xb13a; dump 30000.
move.w after the 0x800010 lookup at 0xad5e, mulu.w at 0xad7e; no other reference.
move.w after the 0x800026 lookup at 0xad72, read at 0xad9e; no other reference.

cm550_tableLookup2D (0x35088) reads (a2) / 2 / 6 / 8 / 0xa / 0xe / 0x10 / 0x14(a2) and writes back +0 / +8: the 22-byte layout is exactly the investigator's (x offset, x pointer, x input, y offset, y pointer, y input, z pointer, no-interpolation flag).
